text.tspan: ESWCap C+R Meter — carrier board Rev C.1
Sheet 5 — R-mode, TIA for 15 MΩ – 1 GΩ (K1 energised, K2 de-energised)
Team Praise Claude · Embedded Systems Workshop · 2026-11-14 · Sheet 5/7
D3 BAT54S Schottky pair clamp: 3 TIA_OUT, 1 GND, 2 +3V3
PCB guard pour at VBIAS around the summing node (P1)
OPAMP1 is off (PA2 Hi-Z); R13 and R14 on the gate (sheet 4) do not matter here. PB14 LOW pulls the gate to ≈ 0.3 V.
V_SH: SH → U9 → R20 → OPAMP3 (follower) → PB1 → ADC3. V_SL: SL → R40 → U1B → VBUF → PB12 → ADC4 (sheet 4).
VBIAS = 1.65 V from R19 10 kΩ (+3V3 → VBIAS) and R21 10 kΩ (VBIAS → GND), C6 100 nF; read on PA5 (J2-11) ADC2_IN13.
U1A holds FL at VBIAS and turns the DUT current into a voltage across Rf: V_TIA = V_FL − I × Rf.
I = (V_SL − V_TIA − V_open) / Rf R = Rf × (V_SH − V_SL) / (V_SL − V_TIA − V_open) (V_open from the open-circuit tare)
blue text = net name (identical to the KiCad schematic)
green dashed box = inside the STM32; ◦ PAx (J2-n) = MCU pin (WeAct header pin)
small numbers next to a part = its pin numbers
